sources.author: Morphed PL
patch_list: Blocks Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Performance and Sessions, plus the built-in Mnemos usage tracker. Push notifications and Firebase Remote Config keep working.
Reports an active Premium capability on every student account and removes the premium lock overlays. Billing and the store stay available.
